dataset_limits: Historical self-selected app reviews are not the complete customer population.
No revenue, plan tier, confirmed cancellation, or causal retention data is available.
Cancellation language is expressed intent, not observed churn.

I_ACCESS.description: Reviewers report being unable to log in or get into their accounts, sometimes repeatedly.

I_BILLING.description: Reviewers describe music access or sign-up as dependent on Prime or Premium, including difficulty reaching the payment prompt.
I_BILLING.issue_name: Paid plan access and sign-up issues

I_CATALOG.description: Reviewers cite missing or removed songs, absent lyrics, and less useful recommendations or repeated DJ selections.

I_DOWNLOADS.description: Reviewers report trouble downloading music, downloads stalling or disappearing, and offline listening failures.

I_OTHER.description: Reviews express general dissatisfaction or say an update needs rework without identifying a more specific product problem.

I_PLAYBACK.description: Reviewers describe playback stopping or failing, connection trouble, reinstall needs, or unexpected song changes.

I_SUPPORT.description: A reviewer characterizes the app's support staff as rude.

I_USABILITY.description: Reviewers mention missing or hard-to-use playback and navigation controls, difficulty finding playlists, and frequent ads.
